requiredBehaviors.behavior: reconstruct the verified project and delivery state from repository evidence and the prior return input
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The hardened project-state reconstruction explicitly includes the previous issue, reviewed head, current head, checks, merge/deployment state and requirement closure, using the return input when available.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve the non-blocking follow-up while marking the completed issue in doNotRepeat
requiredBehaviors.evidence: closed-with-followups preserves later work while closed core work is carried into doNotRepeat.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: choose one small independently verifiable next increment only after prior delivery closure is dispositioned
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The next-increment gate requires the previous iteration to be closed, closed-with-followups or explicitly handled as the current delivery/verification action.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: repeat the merged and requirement-verified issue as the next assignment
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Verified closed work is explicitly transferred to doNotRepeat.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: drop the remaining follow-up merely because the prior core issue is closed
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: closed-with-followups keeps follow-ups visible and separately prioritized.
